reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Morgana Womack
reviews.text: They showed up on time for both the estimate and the service itself. The crew worked fast and safe with several people cleaning as they went. Their clean up went above and beyond to include blowing smaller debris at the end. They cleaned up more than their mess and left my yard nicer than when they arrived. I would definitely use their service again! Their prices were very competitive which was a nice bonus.

reviews.author: Russ Brady
reviews.text: Well, if you are reading this, I am guessing you are looking for a decent tree cutting company. I can tell you right now, your search is over! I rarely ever write reviews, however when a company does the utmost to be professional, courteous, on time and provide quality service I think they deserve my time to reflect this via a review. I have used Anthony's Tree service for three different occasions over the years. EACH TIME, I am so impressed. They have always charged a fair price, are on time, perform quality work and clean up perfectly after each job. The last job was for some trees that were above several of my sheds including one large tree that was totally dead. They took care of all, nothing was damaged and yard was left immaculate. THANK YOU Anthony and team!

reviews.author: John Jang
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with this tree removal company. They exceeded my expectations from start to finish. The team removed the tree professionally and safely, and now my yard looks so much cleaner with a much better view. After the tree removal, they did an amazing job cleaning up. They blew away all the dust and removed every bit of debris, leaving the property spotless. Anthony was especially professional, patient, and very careful with our property throughout the entire process. I strongly recommend this company to anyone needing tree services, and I will definitely be using them again in the future.

reviews.author: Brenda Davis
reviews.text: Anthony’s Tree Service . I had a tree that needed removed and others that had to be trimmed back. This company is so professional and thorough. They were kind and went above and beyond. I highly recommend them. They listen to what the customer wants and the pricing is great. The respect and courtesy is not found in company’s anymore. Anthony is amazing and a person of his word. I will definitely use them in the future. Thank you Anthony’s Tree Service for a job well done and for the thoughtfulness for the extra steps you took to complete the job.

reviews.author: sassyschatz67
reviews.text: AMAZING! AMAZING! AMAZING! Anthony and his crew took care of a 30’ oak tree in my backyard that lost a huge branch during the last storm. Within 4 hours, his crew took care of the tree and stump, removed and cleaned up everything, including the street in front of my house where 2 of their trucks were parked. Additionally, they fixed a few fence boards that were damaged by the fallen branch without even being asked to do so. They worked like a well oiled machine. All that for a great price. Thank you Anthony and the team!

reviews.author: Tee 00
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience with Anthony’s Tree Service. Anthony and his crew are incredibly professional, kind, and meticulous with their work. We had a lot of work done throughout our property, including tree removal and extensive clean-up. The results were amazing, and we received numerous compliments from homeowners in the area. Anthony and his team cleared everything out and left our property looking pristine. It was such a great experience, and I will definitely continue to work with Anthony in the future. Don’t hesitate, go with Anthony’s Tree Service. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Joseph Ward
reviews.text: I have used Anthony's Tree Service several times. Anthony and his crew recently removed 6 trees on my property. He came over within a day of my calling to give an estimated time and price, which was very reasonable. Because of the size of the job, he came on two different days, always calling to advise me of his arrival time and was punctual. He and his crew were very friendly and professional. They were very concerned re safety of the workers, and took great care not to harm the surrounding landscape. They did an excellent job of cleaning up. I would highly recommend Anthony and his tree service, and would not hesitate using him again.

reviews.author: Cheryl Crawford
reviews.text: Anthony was by far one of the nicest, most professional people I’ve ever had the pleasure of working with. His response was quick, and the end product is amazing. He cut down a magnolia tree and 4 cypress trees, removed the debris, and with the unbelievable clean-up, it’s hard to tell trees were ever there. I would definitely hire him again, but all my trees are gone.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Grantham
reviews.text: Anthony is amazing. Refreshingly courteous, personable, and professional. Communication with Anthony was on point, very responsive. I have 11 giant oak and beech trees that I wanted limbed up to 40 feet. While providing the estimate Anthony spotted one that had been struck by lightning and recommended it come down. He was spot on because after it came down it was burned and hollow all the way through. Anthony's price was very reasonable compared to other companies. His team is the hardest working, most organized crew I've seen in years. It was a big job and they went above and beyond to get it done. They cleaned up afterwards better than they found it. I am thrilled with their work and highly recommend them to anyone who needs any type of tree work done. They are the best!

reviews.author: Karen Minetree
reviews.text: We hired Anthony’s Tree Service to remove 3 trees. Anthony made special arrangements to fit us into his schedule today. He and his two crew members arrived early, worked very hard, and cleaned up so that you couldn’t even tell they were there, except for the missing trees. They completed the job using incredible safety and expert precision. After the job was completed, Anthony spent time with us, telling us about his beautiful family and showing us pictures. He shared his faith and talked about how hard he works for his family. We highly recommend Anthony’s Tree Service to anyone looking for a reputable and responsible company. Thanks, Anthony!

reviews.author: Sara Alfred
reviews.text: When meeting Anthony he was friendly and professional. He came out quickly to provide an estimate. His pricing was fair and reasonable. The crew worked efficiently and did a good job cleaning up afterward, leaving most of the property neat and tidy.

reviews.author: Wilford Byrd
reviews.text: I've had the Best experience with Anthony's. Team worked hard and we're courteous. Also they were really careful not to bother my neighbors property. Team arrived on time and finished what I thought was a 2 day job in 1 day. Area was cleaned before leaving a d consulted with me to make sure I was satisfied before packing up. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Lesa Hawn
reviews.text: I texted to get a quote to have a big pecan tree taken down and removed. It was in a bad spot between the garage, a shed, and growing into my fence. He responded quickly, came on Tuesday, gave me a quote. While he was there I asked about some trimming and we discovered a fallen tree that had just come down from the weekend storm. We agreed on a good price for that to be removed too and he and his crew came out on Friday. When he arrived, I asked about another tree and I had that one taken down too. The crew worked fast, efficiently, and cleaned the yard exceptionally well. It took two days to complete the job and I have a new yard, so much light, and peace of mind when the storms come:) I would definitely recommend Anthony to anyone wanting tree service!! Thank you for being a great exemplary model for all businesses!!

reviews.author: Joyce Ritchie
reviews.text: Anthony and his crew are very pleasant to work with. They are extremely professional and get the job done in a timely manner. They did a good job of cleaning up the sight after the tree was taken down. This was a large oak tree and they were able to do the entire tree removal in one day. They are very reasonably priced for the quality of the work done

reviews.author: Christie Davenport
reviews.text: Anthony was easy to contact. He came over and gave us a price to prune two trees in our front yard. We felt it was a very reasonable price. He and his crew came by a few days later. They stayed for about two hours. He consulted me on everything they did and asked my opinion about the results before they left. Anthony and his guys were very nice and professional. They cleaned up after themselves. Our yard looked better after he left than when he got there. I highly recommend. We will be hiring him again when we save some money for trees in our back yard.

reviews.author: Maribel Clemente
reviews.text: We had a tree that was sick and at risk of falling on our roof. We called to a company that gave us an appointment for August, so I decided to try another person. Anthony came and gave us priority due to the risk. In a matter of days, they were here cutting the tree. They did an amazing job!!!! I'm so grateful!! They cleaned up everything. I definitely recommend this tree services.

reviews.author: Cindy Klumb
reviews.text: Anthony and his team did an excellent job on removing a dead tree and trimming several others. They also did a great job cleaning up. I have and will continue to recommend his services to friends and family.

reviews.author: Steve Midlik
reviews.text: We have a big oak tree in front yard that we wanted trimmed off the house. Anthony came the next day to provide a quote and then returned a few days later to perform the job. We are blown away by the detail of his team’s work. Not only is our house safe from limbs, but his team also kept the tree symmetrical. Last but not least, his team left the yard in better shape than when he got here. My wife and I are extremely happy and would definitely recommend him for any tree service.

reviews.author: Yomara Guzman
reviews.text: When I can honestly say over the years I've knows Anthony and his crew. Excellent service. Quality if phenomenal, very understanding, best quotes. Anyone that is looking for clean, efficient work. Hit Anthony up, he works around your schedule and will you not be disappointed. The job that they do; speaks alone.

reviews.author: Dorothy Goduti
reviews.text: Anthony’s was absolutely above and beyond! Prompt, courteous and very professional. Gigantic limb broke off in old tulip tree and lodged in another branch. Anthony effortlessly removed and disposed of debris. Would highly recommend to anyone in need of tree service!

reviews.author: Carrie Mokry
reviews.text: Stellar experience with Tony and his team! Reasonable price for quality work. Tony's suggestion for how to best prune my trees was spot on. They look great! Fast service and not a leaf left on the ground. Very professional. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Cathy Jackson
reviews.text: Anthony and his crew did an amazing job! Very professional and courteous with great communication skills. Will definitely refer them to all of my clients. Hard working team!

reviews.author: John Roberts
reviews.text: Excellent job trimming trees and bushes at a very reasonable rate! Definitely recommend and will use again in the future. Anthony was professional and friendly! You will not regret going with this team.

reviews.author: G Hays (crossbonesjeep)
reviews.text: These guys did an amazing job. They are professional and friendly and not only did a great job taking down the tree the clean up was top notch also. I Highly recommend them for any tree removal. Thanks Guys

reviews.author: Kimberly Metcalf
reviews.text: Anthony and his team were wonderful! They were very reasonably priced, quick to respond, and did a great job! I had multiple trees trimmed and they exceeded my expectations.

reviews.author: Jason Lawrence
reviews.text: Anthony and his team did a great job! All around great guy and the team was wonderful. Started with just 2 trees and ended up cutting a third tree down and another 40 bushes. I would highly recommend giving him a call!

reviews.author: Noreen Taylor
reviews.text: Needed 2 Trees removed from my Property and after 3 Quotes Anthony's Tree Service quoted best price. Talked to Anthony's last week and appt was made for a week later. This team came out in freezing weather and removed the 2 Trees and cleaned up all debris in about 6 hrs. I highly recommend Anthony's Tree Service for any tree removal you.

reviews.author: Sheree Mosby
reviews.text: Anthony has helped me with problem trees four times. The latest job was to cut down two trees, one was leaning pretty good and the other was a dying pine tree. These two trees were enormous and the earth shook when the cut sections fell to the ground. Anthony and crew were so careful not to damage anything nearby, including my fence and shrubbery. This crew deserves more than five stars. All were polite and hard-working and they left my yard as neat as can be. The stumps were grinded down, the area was smoothed out and all debris was hauled away. I highly recommend Anthony’s Tree Service. Anthony’s Tree Service just completed another job for me. They cut down two trees and removed an old shrub to make room for a shed. Anthony takes such care in his work. His team is the same. I’ve asked them to return in the spring to help with some heavy yard work. The fees are very reasonable, as well. I highly recommend these guys. They are prompt and polite. 5 stars!!

reviews.author: Miles Suttle
reviews.text: First class on all fronts. You will find no better price nor will you find a better man to do business with. His tree work is top notch along with stump removal, clean up and most importantly attention to detail when it comes to trimming limbs/branches/etc. in areas that one cannot get to both before and after the work is done.

reviews.author: Becky Boxx
reviews.text: Anthony and his crew did an amazing job. Other than the trees being trimmed up you would have never known they were ever here. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Amanda Asbell
reviews.text: Excellent service, very professional, fair price and we have 5 more trees we're going to have them do. Five stars all around.

reviews.author: Cassandra
reviews.text: EXCELLENT SERVICE! They were on time, they protected my house as they worked, and they explained everything they were going to do before they got started. Professional and very friendly- I highly recommend them!! Lucretia Melton

reviews.author: Tim Kozlowski
reviews.text: Great communication with Anthony. The ground crew was great and cleaned up and removed all debris. Reasonable price and timely work. Hire them.

reviews.author: Jeanne Faciane
reviews.text: Anthony’s crew was right on time. Anthony gave advice to help the two trees which were black walnut and pecan on what limbs to cut to keep healthy trees. I was amazed on the time it took, the clean up and, professionalism. Anthony and crew was polite and took the time to talk to me, as well as looked at there work twice to be sure I was satisfied. I would recommend them to who ever needs a tree job done correctly. Thanks Anthony for doing such a great job you and your crew are awesome!!

reviews.author: Karen Keene
reviews.text: Anthony and his crew did a great job cutting down my trees. This is the second time Anthony has done tree cutting for us, and he always does a great job. If you need tree cutting services, I highly recommend using Anthony and his crew.

reviews.author: Veronda Lee
reviews.text: Great customer service!! They arrived on time and completed the job safely and fast! They exceeded my expectations! Very affordable!

reviews.author: Jessica
reviews.text: It just so happened that over the course of a few days I saw Anthony’s tree service at several houses in my neighborhood doing tree work. I decided to give them a call to have a stump removed. They came over and handled it before the end of the day at a very reasonable price, were very clean, professional and did a wonderful job !!!

reviews.author: Laurie Pillow
reviews.text: Anthony and his crew provide amazing service! This is the second time I’ve used this company. Highlights: great prices, good people, true experts. Anthony took time to walk around my yard and explain all the details. He was patient and transparent about the pros and cons of removing/trimming each tree. He offered several options to accommodate my budget and tight time frame. I especially appreciate his transparency, offering a reasonable price and a concrete date (without tossing out an exorbitant number and making us both waste time negotiating to a decent price.) I couldn’t recommend this company more. It was a pleasure to work with them. They’re polite, timely, and insanely meticulous about the tree-cutting process as well as the clean-up!

reviews.author: Noel Robinson
reviews.text: Absolute most amazing tree service company in the world. Worked around our schedule and are very safe and affordable.

reviews.author: David Knoll
reviews.text: I have contracted with Anthony’s Tree Service for about 10 years. He and his crew always do an outstanding job. They are prompt and usually finish the job in one day. They do a great job of clean upon completion of the job. I priced several tree services and he always has the most reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Michelle Hays
reviews.text: Posting for my mother, Nancy Grew. This was my third time hiring Anthony's Tree Service to complete work on my property. Anthony and his crew pruned and trimmed numerous trees for me. They did an excellent job and left the property immaculate.

reviews.author: Annette Hill
reviews.text: I am so very impressed with Anthony's Tree Service. They took great care of my property. They even placed plywood on the ground around the tree before they began work. Our tree was very old and large, but they took it down with ease. When the work was done, my yard was so clean, if it weren't for the missing tree, you wouldn't know they had been there. On top of the fantastic job, they gave us the best price out of several estimates. If you want the best job at a great price, Anthony's Tree Service is the one to call. See Before and After Pictures Below.

reviews.author: David Uhrich
reviews.text: I highly recommend Anthony’s! He and his crew were professional, efficient and thorough. I was pleased by the job quote and turned the guys loose. They knocked it out of the park…took down the trees, chipped and removed everything, sensitive to street traffic, spectacular clean up and just great to work with. Give Anthony a call…you won’t be disappointed. David in Running Man

reviews.author: Fairsie Chirico
reviews.text: Anthony's Tree Service is my "go to" for ALL of my business and personal tree work, tree removal and stump removal. Professional, knowledgeable, courteous. Does the job for a fair price and leaves the job site clean of all debris. I've had the pleasure of working with Anthony and his team over 10 times in the last 8 years! Couldn't ask for better service!

reviews.author: Laura González Castro
reviews.text: Anthony and his guys are great. We have a tree that was very risky to my house and he came immediately and did a great job. We really appreciate his work and we feel safer now at home. They were punctual and very responsible.

reviews.author: Donald Brunk
reviews.text: I'm a repeat customer of Anthony's Tree Service for tree removal and stump grinding. They have always done good work at good prices. Easy to work with.

reviews.author: VELTON SHAW
reviews.text: Just had some bushes trimmed and others removed this morning by Anthony's Tree Service and we are very pleased with the quality of work they did. They arrived on time, did a tremendous job and cleaned up once they were done. My husband and I have used them before and will definitely use them again. I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Faye B
reviews.text: I called Anthony's for an estimate to trim tree branches off my garage from a fallen tree on my neighbor's property. Anthony came out couple days later, inspected the location and provided a reasonable estimate. Anthony was available to do the removal the next day. He and his team arrived on time and went to work. He had me check around to ensure I was pleased with their work which I was. They raked the leaves and sticks from the work area and grinded the branches. I would definitely use Anthony's services again. They were professional and polite.

reviews.author: Kimberly Brickhouse
reviews.text: We've used Anthony's Tree Service for years. He and his crew always does an awesome job and cleans up afterwards as if they'd never been there.

reviews.author: Fernando Blanco luna
reviews.text: I called Anthony’s tree service to get a quote on Friday to get a big 60 foot tree cut down in my front yard. Anthony had the quote to me onsite and was very knowledgeable, professional and very friendly. Finding good customer service is hard to find these days but this guy was a good business man. We agreed to the price and he was at my house on Tuesday with his crew and a lot of equipment. His crew was on top of their job and they made the job look easy. They finished the job perfectly with no problems and looked like they were never here. Great job to Anthony for having a professional team and doing a great safe job at my home.

reviews.author: Lakesha Smith
reviews.text: I wanted to take a moment to express my sincere gratitude for the exceptional tree cutting service your team provided. From start to finish, the experience was seamless and professional. The crew arrived on time and they were careful to ensure the safety of my property while efficiently removing the dead tree in my back yard. They even took the time to clean up thoroughly after the job was done thank you:) . I would highly recommend Anthony's Tree Service to anyone in need of tree removal. Thank you again for your outstanding work!

reviews.author: Gwendolyn "Gigi" Miranda
reviews.text: Very professional service. Anthony worked with my mother to get the service that she needed. We are very pleased with the job he did. We will be sure to call him for additional projects in the future.

reviews.author: steve brown
reviews.text: Can highly recommend Anthony's Tree service for both quality of service as well as affordability. As General Manager of Peninsula Memorial Park Cemetery in Newport News, VA. I have had a number of opportunities to work with Anthony on varias tree removal and tree trimming projects. His work has been very concise, professional and far less expensive than quotes from other tree removal companies in the area. It's one thing to take down a tree but I was also impressed with the cleanliness of the area once the job was completed. You won't be sorry if you give him a chance to take a look at your challenge.

reviews.author: J Bart
reviews.text: Anthony's Tree Service did an exceptional job and prevented a tree from falling on our house! They cut down a large tree in our front yard, ground up the stump, cleaned up the area and left it so no one would ever know a tree had been there in the first place. We had received several estimates for the removal of a large tree in our front yard from about five different tree removal companies. Anthony was by far the most reasonable and we could tell from the first moment we met him, that he was actually concerned about our safety. We felt a sense of peace when speaking with him, unlike the other companies. He came out with his crew, all professionals, who worked non-stop as a well-oiled machine. I watched them the entire time and was extremely impressed with the way they worked so well together. When they left, there was no sign they had ever even been here - that's how meticulous their clean up process was. The only thing that was different was that the tree, which had been threatening our house, was now gone. We found out about Anthony through a neighbor who was thrilled with the job he had done for her and recommended him highly. I would like to pass on that same blessing to anyone else who is wondering who they should trust to help them in a similar situation. I hope that anyone reading this who is considering having a tree removed will call Anthony. I have found Anthony to be a man of his word and a trustworthy business owner and that seems to be such a rare find these days. Call Anthony. You will be very glad you did.

reviews.author: Samuel Morgan
reviews.text: Anthony’s Tree Service did a great job on our tree project. Anthony’s pricing was very reasonable and he and his crew were very professional and efficient throughout including careful attention to cleanup. I highly recommend Anthony’s Tree Service for any tree project and would not hesitate to call them again!

reviews.author: Bert H
reviews.text: I found this coumppony in 2019 and was so impressed just use them again and I'm even more inpressed the quality is untouchable very impressive coumppony. Bert hawkes

reviews.author: Dr. Allen R. Jones, Jr.
reviews.text: Anthony tree service is the best company for your tree needs. I have required and benefited from his skills for a number of years and he has never dissatisfied me. I trust him implicitly with my personal home and rental properties. His pricing is fair and he is dependable. Simply the best!! Dr. Jones

reviews.author: Reese Cagle
reviews.text: We recently used Anthony’s Tree Service to remove four trees from our backyard, and they did a fantastic job! The team was fast, friendly, and made sure everything was done right. I was really impressed with their work and wouldn’t hesitate to call them again for any tree removal needs.

reviews.author: Carl Ennis
reviews.text: Fantastic job. Anthony and his crew were very careful and very safe. They handled all equipment eight super expertise. Best I have seen. Trust him completely.

reviews.author: Rafi Moon
reviews.text: Anthony’s company is really remarkable in its operation. Fast and dependable. Reasonable pricing estimates. I would really recommend him and his crew.

reviews.author: Carlos Pabon
reviews.text: Anthony has cut many trees at my house and he has been only but professional, responsive and is a well organized company. He has well trained workers that know how to do their job. Their customer service is hard to find now of days. I would definitely recommend Anthony’s tree service to anyone that wants fair pricing ,good customer service, and professional people working around their home.

reviews.author: Mariah
reviews.text: The crew arrived on time, assessed the situation carefully, and executed the removal flawlessly, no damage, no mess, just pure skill. It was like watching a well-rehearsed operation. They even cleaned up thoroughly afterward, leaving the area safer and tidier than before. If you're looking for a reliable, knowledgeable tree service that takes safety and quality seriously, look no further. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kenny Williamson
reviews.text: Anthony and his crew are TOP NOTCH!!!!!! I hired Anthony to remove a giant pine tree that was leaning towards my home. Anthony is extremely knowledgeable about what he does and is very personable!!!!! I would recommend him 100%!!!!!! He’s the best in the business in my opinion!!!!

reviews.author: Thaddeus Holloman
reviews.text: Anthony’s Tree Service does great work. They are fair in pricing and do what they say they will do. I have used them twice and have been pleased.

reviews.author: Kristeena White
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing crew. Very Knowledgeable, professional and reasonable priced. Arrived on time. Kept me informed on the progress of the job. Removed tree, grinded the stump and did a great job cleaning up afterwards. I highly recommend Anthony’s Tree Service for all your tree removal needs. I will not hesitate to hire them again.

reviews.author: Jim Butler
reviews.text: Anthony and his crew did a great job taking down several trees around the house. They worked safely and efficiently, never had any worries about the trees or branches falling on the house. Did an excellent job cleaning up afterward, would never know they had been here.

reviews.author: Jorge Polyzos
reviews.text: I’ve used Anthony Tree Service for a lot of jobs the last year. Anthony and his crew has been very professional and reliable. I know I can count on him to take care of any tree issues I have no matter the size!

reviews.author: Kathy & Brian Dunn
reviews.text: Very friendly, professional and skilled tree service. Ours was a very large tree and, because of it's location, crane removal was not an option. Anthony & his crew did a wonderful job taking it down and then putting up our new fence as well. Most impressive was that, at the end of every workday, they cleaned up their work area completely as though the weren't coming back the next day to continue the work. Very thorough, courteous and capable - Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Carlos gonzalez
reviews.text: Anthony and his crew are outstanding!! They are very professional and always keep safety a priority. We had a tree between two power lines and they swiftly and safely took it down. Would recommend to anyone who needs any tree service done!

reviews.author: Paul Washington
reviews.text: Great work done by the crew. Cleaned up the yard after completion of pruning and trimming the tree to my satisfaction.

reviews.author: Susan Nuttycombe
reviews.text: Top notch service!! Anthony and his team are very efficient and do a great job of cleaning up. His prices are extremely competitive-best price out of four quoted. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.text: Anthony and his team were phenomenal. The safety and precision of their teamwork speaks volumes about them being masters of their craft. I would have no hesitancy recommending them as a best value and my first choice. Bravo Anthony and crew, job well done.

reviews.text: Anthony's provide a competitive quote, quick response time and excellent service. They removed 4 large trees and stump grinding and clean up. I would highly recommend.

reviews.text: Two of my neighbors used Anthony’s tree service and was recommended to me. Very friendly and professional .. not a fly by night company . A great team of hard working men . They worked tirelessly and cleaned up as they went. I will use this company again in the future. Great job Anthony!

reviews.text: Anthony’s Tree Service was knowledgeable and Skilled in cutting down the trees near my home. They showed up on time. Their price was reasonable. D.J

reviews.author: Jim Ed Crouch
reviews.text: Anthony did a very professional job, from beginning to end. Afterwards, he left our property in immaculate condition with his thorough cleanup. I will definitely hire him again.

reviews.author: Rodney Day
reviews.text: Anthony’s Tree Service was doing a job in my neighborhood when I approached Anthony for a quote on my large pine tree. This quote was fair considering other quotes that I had received. They are a very professional group and do an awesome job with cleanup at its best. I would highly recommend this tree service.

reviews.author: David Walmsley
reviews.text: Awesome company to work with. I had a tree fall in my yard. They were recommended to me so I contacted them. Came by and gave me an estimate. He gave me the best quote. Came to my home and quickly cut up and removed the tree. I would highly recommend them and would use them again.

reviews.author: Beverly McDonald
reviews.text: Twice, in the past, high winds have blown over 2 large oak trees in my yard. Anthony and his crew were efficient and focused on cutting up the trees and clean-up and removal. This week I again called on Anthony and his crew to take down 2 dead trees. They quickly got to work, took down the trees, cut then up and removed all the debris. I highly recommend Anthony's Tree Service.

reviews.author: Ann Gupta
reviews.text: We’ve had Anthony’s take trees out at our home and at our rental. I’d use them over and over again. They are responsive, professional, and reasonably priced. I would recommend them above any other tree removal company.

reviews.author: Donna Richbourg
reviews.text: Anthony’s Tree Service did an Outstanding job removing a tree that had fallen in back yard, cutting two trees and trimming two trees. The owner and employees are very professional and the cost was very affordable!

reviews.author: Melissa Payne
reviews.text: Very happy with the service provided. I needed a tree cut down in my front yard and they were able to come the following week. The team came on time and cleaned up everything afterwards. Communication was very responsive and pricing was fair. Would definitely recommend and will use them again in the future!

reviews.author: Clayton Blosser
